youtube.baslik: To train the weak ear, why is the strong ear turned down? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Dichotic training programs have been developed for children with one clearly weaker ear on dichotic tests: different stimuli are given to both ears at the same time, while the level of the strong ear is lowered somewhat, giving the weak ear an advantage in the competition. As the child succeeds, the level difference between the ears is reduced; some studies show that these programs improve dichotic test results, but samples are usually small.
